// This file is not part of the operator build. TestTSDProxyCompat copies it
// into tsdproxy's internal/config package, in a temporary copy of tsdproxy's
// source, so that the operator's rendered tsdproxy.yaml is loaded and
// validated by tsdproxy's own code, following the same steps as
// config.InitializeConfig.

package config

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/creasty/defaults"
	"github.com/rs/zerolog"
)

func TestOperatorCompat(t *testing.T) {
	dir := os.Getenv("OPERATOR_COMPAT_DIR")
	if dir == "" {
		t.Skip("OPERATOR_COMPAT_DIR not set")
	}

	files, err := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(dir, "main-*.yaml"))
	if err != nil || len(files) == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("no main-*.yaml fixtures in %s (err=%v)", dir, err)
	}

	for _, file := range files {
		t.Run(filepath.Base(file), func(t *testing.T) {
			// The pod only sets the client ID variable for OAuth instances.
			if strings.Contains(filepath.Base(file), "oauth") {
				t.Setenv("TSDPROXY_TAILSCALE_DEFAULT_CLIENTID", "compat-client-id")
			}

			log := zerolog.Nop()
			cfg := &Data{}
			cfg.Tailscale.Providers = make(map[string]*TailscaleServerConfig)
			cfg.Docker = make(map[string]*DockerTargetProviderConfig)
			cfg.Lists = make(map[string]*ListTargetProviderConfig)
			cfg.Incus = make(map[string]*IncusTargetProviderConfig)
			cfg.Proxmox = make(map[string]*ProxmoxTargetProviderConfig)
			cfg.DNSProviders = make(map[string]*DNSProviderConfig)
			cfg.TLSProviders = make(map[string]*TLSProviderConfig)

			if err := NewConfigFile(log, file, cfg).Load(); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("load: %v", err)
			}
			if err := defaults.Set(cfg); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("defaults: %v", err)
			}
			if err := cfg.loadSecretsFromFiles(); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("secrets: %v", err)
			}
			cfg.loadTailscaleAuthKeyEnvOverrides()
			cfg.LoadTailscaleEnvOverrides()
			if err := cfg.validate(log); err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("validate: %v", err)
			}

			if cfg.HTTP.Hostname != "0.0.0.0" || cfg.HTTP.Port != 8080 {
				t.Errorf("http = %s:%d, want 0.0.0.0:8080", cfg.HTTP.Hostname, cfg.HTTP.Port)
			}
			if cfg.AdminAllowLocalhost {
				t.Error("adminAllowLocalhost is enabled")
			}
			if cfg.APIKey.Value() != "compat-api-key" {
				t.Errorf("apiKey not loaded from apiKeyFile, got %q", cfg.APIKey.Value())
			}
			if len(cfg.Docker)+len(cfg.Incus)+len(cfg.Proxmox) != 0 {
				t.Error("unexpected non-list target providers")
			}
			list, ok := cfg.Lists["kubernetes"]
			if !ok || len(cfg.Lists) != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("lists = %v, want exactly \"kubernetes\"", cfg.Lists)
			}
			if list.DefaultProxyProvider != "default" {
				t.Errorf("list defaultProxyProvider = %q", list.DefaultProxyProvider)
			}

			p, ok := cfg.Tailscale.Providers["default"]
			if !ok || len(cfg.Tailscale.Providers) != 1 {
				t.Fatalf("providers = %v, want exactly \"default\"", cfg.Tailscale.Providers)
			}
			if strings.Contains(filepath.Base(file), "oauth") {
				if !hasOAuthCredentials(p) || p.ClientSecret.Value() != "compat-client-secret" {
					t.Error("OAuth credentials not resolved from clientSecretFile and environment")
				}
				if !p.Services || p.Hostname == "" || p.Tags == "" {
					t.Errorf("services provider incomplete: services=%v hostname=%q tags=%q",
						p.Services, p.Hostname, p.Tags)
				}
			} else if p.AuthKey.Value() != "compat-authkey" {
				t.Errorf("authKey not loaded from authKeyFile, got %q", p.AuthKey.Value())
			}
		})
	}
}
